name: Ackermans & Van Haaren NV
summary: Ackermans & Van Haaren NV engages in marine engineering and contracting, private banking, real estate, energy and resources, and growth capital businesses worldwide. The Marine Engineering & Contracting segment engages in the marine construction activities, including dredging and civil works on water, as well as offshore activities in the areas of renewable energy, oil and gas, soil and sludge remediation, and aggregate and mineral extraction; real estate development, multitechnics, and construction and renovation activities; and development of port projects and related industrial zones, as well as offshore wind farms.
